_comment: Variables of the T1 table agregados-municipios: values published by IBGE per municipality, copied as shipped (no estimation). Read by assemble_aggregates.py (sources) and build_variables.py (VARIABLES catalog). source: fracamo = FRACAMO.TXT of the sample microdata (columns fraction, households, persons); xls = folder of zipped per-UF spreadsheets, column = header label in the spreadsheet. sum_checks: {total: [[parts], ...]} must hold exactly in every municipality. additive (default true): the UF total row of the spreadsheet must equal the sum of its municipalities.

variables.name: V001
variables.description_pt: População residente (universo), segundo o arquivo auxiliar FRACAMO.TXT dos microdados da amostra
variables.description_en: Resident population (universe), according to the auxiliary file FRACAMO.TXT of the sample microdata

variables.name: V002
variables.description_en: Permanent private households (universe), according to FRACAMO.TXT

variables.name: V003
variables.description_en: Effective sampling fraction (%), according to FRACAMO.TXT

variables.name: V008
variables.description_pt: Índice de Gini publicado pelo IBGE (planilhas GINI91, 1995). O conceito de renda não é documentado na fonte, não é reproduzido exatamente pelos microdados da amostra (o rendimento do chefe do domicílio é o mais próximo). -9999 onde a planilha não traz o município
variables.description_en: Gini index published by IBGE (GINI91 spreadsheets, 1995). The income concept is not documented in the source, and the sample microdata do not reproduce it exactly (the household head's income is the closest). -9999 where the spreadsheet lacks the municipality
